parameters.query:
-- Get student dashboard summary
SELECT * FROM student_dashboard_summary WHERE student_id = $1

-- Get recent activity
SELECT 
  event_type,
  resource_type,
  resource_id,
  metadata,
  timestamp
FROM learning_events
WHERE student_id = $1
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 10

-- Get topic mastery overview
SELECT * FROM topic_progress_overview 
WHERE student_id = $1
  AND ($2::integer IS NULL OR subject_id = $2)
ORDER BY mastery_level DESC

-- Get detailed topic mastery
SELECT 
  stm.*,
  t.topic_name,
  t.topic_code,
  t.specification_ref,
  t.difficulty_level,
  t.estimated_hours,
  s.subject_name,
  s.exam_board
FROM student_topic_mastery stm
JOIN topics t ON stm.topic_id = t.topic_id
JOIN subjects s ON t.subject_id = s.subject_id
WHERE stm.student_id = $1 AND stm.topic_id = $2

-- Get confidence history for topic
SELECT 
  confidence_rating,
  context,
  notes,
  logged_at
FROM confidence_logs
WHERE student_id = $1 AND topic_id = $2
ORDER BY logged_at DESC
LIMIT 20

-- Get recent attempts for this topic
SELECT 
  spa.attempt_id,
  spa.marks_awarded,
  spa.marks_possible,
  spa.is_correct,
  spa.attempted_at,
  pq.question_text,
  pq.difficulty
FROM student_practice_attempts spa
JOIN practice_questions pq ON spa.question_id = pq.question_id
WHERE spa.student_id = $1 AND pq.topic_id = $2
ORDER BY spa.attempted_at DESC
LIMIT 10

-- Update confidence rating
INSERT INTO confidence_logs (student_id, topic_id, confidence_rating, context, logged_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 'self_assessment', NOW());

-- Update topic mastery confidence
INSERT INTO student_topic_mastery (student_id, topic_id, confidence_level, updated_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, NOW())
ON CONFLICT (student_id, topic_id)
DO UPDATE SET
  confidence_level = $3,
  updated_at = NOW();

SELECT * FROM student_topic_mastery WHERE student_id = $1 AND topic_id = $2;
